title: Detailed corn cob
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='husk' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8fd94e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#4f9e2c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cob' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe36b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f5a623'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer husk leaves -->
  <path d='M30 18 C18 30 14 55 22 78 C26 88 32 92 36 90 C30 70 30 40 38 22 Z' fill='url(#husk)' stroke='#b6ec7a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M70 18 C82 30 86 55 78 78 C74 88 68 92 64 90 C70 70 70 40 62 22 Z' fill='#6fbf3a' stroke='#b6ec7a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- inner leaves behind cob -->
  <path d='M36 26 C30 45 32 68 40 86 L46 80 C40 62 40 44 44 28 Z' fill='#7ecb45' stroke='#b6ec7a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M64 26 C70 45 68 68 60 86 L54 80 C60 62 60 44 56 28 Z' fill='#63b034' stroke='#b6ec7a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- cob body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='17' ry='36' fill='url(#cob)' stroke='#fff1a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- kernels: rows -->
  <g fill='#ffd23f' stroke='#fff6c2' stroke-width='0.8'>
    <!-- col x offsets -12,-6,0,6,12 with rows -->
    <!-- row 1 y=26 -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='3'/><circle cx='50' cy='26' r='3'/><circle cx='56' cy='26' r='3'/>
    <!-- row 2 y=34 -->
    <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='3.2'/><circle cx='47' cy='34' r='3.2'/><circle cx='53' cy='34' r='3.2'/><circle cx='60' cy='34' r='3.2'/>
    <!-- row 3 y=42 -->
    <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='3.4'/><circle cx='45' cy='42' r='3.4'/><circle cx='50' cy='42' r='3.4'/><circle cx='55' cy='42' r='3.4'/><circle cx='62' cy='42' r='3.4'/>
    <!-- row 4 y=50 -->
    <circle cx='37' cy='50' r='3.6'/><circle cx='44' cy='50' r='3.6'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='3.6'/><circle cx='56' cy='50' r='3.6'/><circle cx='63' cy='50' r='3.6'/>
    <!-- row 5 y=58 -->
    <circle cx='37' cy='58' r='3.6'/><circle cx='44' cy='58' r='3.6'/><circle cx='50' cy='58' r='3.6'/><circle cx='56' cy='58' r='3.6'/><circle cx='63' cy='58' r='3.6'/>
    <!-- row 6 y=66 -->
    <circle cx='38' cy='66' r='3.4'/><circle cx='45' cy='66' r='3.4'/><circle cx='50' cy='66' r='3.4'/><circle cx='55' cy='66' r='3.4'/><circle cx='62' cy='66' r='3.4'/>
    <!-- row 7 y=74 -->
    <circle cx='40' cy='74' r='3.2'/><circle cx='47' cy='74' r='3.2'/><circle cx='53' cy='74' r='3.2'/><circle cx='60' cy='74' r='3.2'/>
    <!-- row 8 y=81 -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='81' r='3'/><circle cx='50' cy='81' r='3'/><circle cx='56' cy='81' r='3'/>
  </g>
  <!-- kernel highlight glaze down center -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='11' ry='30' fill='#fff4b8' opacity='0.28'/>
  <!-- pointed tip of cob at bottom -->
  <path d='M50 88 L46 92 L50 94 L54 92 Z' fill='#f5a623' stroke='#ffe36b' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- silk at top -->
  <g stroke='#e8d38a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M50 18 C48 12 52 8 50 3'/>
    <path d='M50 18 C44 13 42 8 39 5'/>
    <path d='M50 18 C56 13 58 8 61 5'/>
    <path d='M50 18 C47 11 44 9 46 4'/>
  </g>
  <!-- leaf tip highlights -->
  <path d='M33 24 C27 40 28 58 34 74' stroke='#c9f294' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M67 24 C73 40 72 58 66 74' stroke='#9fe05c' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
